summary: Iteration 12 — Phase 6 (Schedule & Publish System) full validation: backend 13/13 phase6 pytests pass in 3.23s, Phase 3/4/5 regression 18/18 pytests pass in 32.81s (total 31/31 = 100%). Background scheduler verified running every 30s ('Publishing scheduler started (interval=30s)' in supervisor backend.err.log). Frontend: all 13 AI-Ads sub-tabs (Campaign Builder, Social, Email, SMS, Image Studio, Video Studio, Library, Calendar, Queue, Automations, Providers, Analytics, Settings) render with ZERO page errors. Calendar: 6 controls present (month/week/day/prev/next/today) + 35 day cells in month view. Queue: all 4 columns (queued/publishing/published/failed) + provider-filter + refresh present. Providers: all 10 cards present (facebook, instagram, google_business, mailchimp, email, sms as real with Connect; tiktok, linkedin, x, youtube as coming_soon with disabled Connect + 'COMING SOON' badge — confirmed visually in screenshot). Automations: rule form renders. Library: 14 schedule buttons with data-testid='ai-asset-{id}-schedule' present; click opens SchedulePopover with provider/when/btn/publish-now-btn testids. END-TO-END INTEGRATION TEST PASSED: created asset → scheduled in past → appeared in Queue 'queued' column → POST /api/ai-ads/run-due-now executed it → status flipped to 'published' with external_id='sim_facebook_02685d9ccd' → calendar shows green → 3 audit log entries written to publish_logs collection. All real provider publishes intentionally simulated (return success=True, external_id 'sim_*') per architecture note since no live credentials supplied.
action_items: OPTIONAL (carry-over from iter 11): silence 6× Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings on AI Ads → Analytics sub-tab (cosmetic dev-mode noise; charts render).

OPTIONAL: RBAC/permissions enforcement is documented as not-yet-enforced (single-admin password). Flagged in the request itself — fine for current scope, recommend roles middleware before multi-tenant rollout.

FUTURE: replace simulation publishers with live API integrations once Facebook/IG/Mailchimp/SendGrid/Twilio credentials are supplied via the Provider Connections UI (architecture already in place — base.py / providers.py just need real SDK calls).
critical_code_review_comments: publishing/ module is well-structured: base.py (provider interface), providers.py (10 publishers), scheduler.py (background loop). Good separation.
routers/publishing.py at ~430 lines is appropriately scoped — below the 700-line bright-line. CRUD for automations + connections + queue + calendar + logs all live here cohesively.
Audit logging works: every schedule/cancel/reschedule/publish writes to publish_logs (verified — 3 entries observed for a single sched→publish→complete flow). Good for compliance.
Provider Connections endpoint correctly redacts secrets: response body['credentials']['page_id'] returned as '***' (verified in test_provider_connect_disconnect). No credential leak.
Background scheduler started via asyncio.create_task in startup; logs confirm 'Publishing scheduler started (interval=30s)' on each backend reload — clean lifecycle.

Rate-limit decorator removal from POST /api/ai-ads/schedule, /publish, /bundle-schedule was the right call given the slowapi+Pydantic body conflict — rate-limits remain on the LLM-generation endpoints where they matter most.
frontend testid coverage is excellent: every interactive element on Calendar/Queue/Providers/Automations/Library Schedule popover has a data-testid — made automated verification trivial.

Multi-tenant readiness: business_id field defaulted to 'default' on all 4 new collections (scheduled_posts, publish_logs, provider_connections, automation_rules) — good forward design even though only one tenant exists today.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 13 sub-tabs render, 0 page errors, all data-testid selectors found, end-to-end schedule→publish flow works)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 transient asset 'ITER12_INT_*' for the end-to-end integration test and deleted it. Phase 6 fixture creates/deletes its own 'PHASE6_TEST_*' asset. No persistent test pollution.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 6 Schedule & Publish System is fully operational and verified end-to-end. All 31 backend pytests green (13 phase6 + 18 phase345 regression). Frontend: 13 AI-Ads sub-tabs, all data-testid selectors present, zero console/page errors. Integration flow verified via API: schedule in past → queue→queued → POST /api/ai-ads/run-due-now → queue→published with sim_* external_id → calendar shows published green → publish_logs has audit trail. Background scheduler ticks every 30s (autonomous). All 6 real publishers (facebook/instagram/google_business/mailchimp/email/sms) simulate success — replace with live SDK calls once user supplies API credentials via Provider Connections UI. 4 coming_soon providers (tiktok/linkedin/x/youtube) correctly registered + disabled. Rate-limits intentionally removed from POST /schedule/publish/bundle-schedule (slowapi conflicts with Pydantic body params). RBAC not yet enforced — single-admin auth model.
rca of the issue: No new bugs found in iteration 12. Carry-over from iter 11 (Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on Analytics sub-tab) remains cosmetic only — charts render correctly; ResponsiveContainer measures parent at -1 on first mount of conditionally-rendered sub-tab.
